title: Renamed authoring requests
description: On stdout, once, right after `renamed_installs`, when --rename-course is given: how many authoring requests (RFC 9 §5.5) now name `to`. Their drafts and decisions name the request, not the course. Separate from `renamed` and `renamed_installs`, whose schemas are unchanged.

kind.description: The program that printed the line.

run.description: One id per invocation, on every line it prints.

at.description: When the line was printed, UTC.

authoring_requests.description: Authoring request rows that were renamed.
